ARTICLES.title: India finish fourth at Aichi-Nagoya with 85 medals
ARTICLES.body: 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze: India's second-best Asian Games haul, behind Hangzhou.

hi.title: भारत ऐची-नगोया में 85 पदकों के साथ चौथे स्थान पर
hi.body: 21 स्वर्ण, 27 रजत और 37 कांस्य: हांगझोऊ के बाद एशियाई खेलों में भारत का दूसरा सबसे अच्छा प्रदर्शन।
paras: भारत ने ऐची-नगोया में 20वें एशियाई खेलों का समापन 85 पदकों के साथ किया: 21 स्वर्ण, 27 रजत और 37 कांस्य। इस प्रदर्शन के साथ भारत पदक तालिका में चीन, जापान और दक्षिण कोरिया के बाद चौथे स्थान पर रहा।

यह संख्या हांगझोऊ (2023 में आयोजित) के रिकॉर्ड 107 पदकों से कम है, लेकिन एशियाई खेलों के इतिहास में भारत का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा पदक आंकड़ा है। सबसे व्यस्त दिन 2 अक्टूबर रहा, जब 12 पदक आए और उनमें छह स्वर्ण थे।

हॉकी पुरुष और महिला दोनों वर्गों में स्वर्ण जीतने वाला तीसरा भारतीय टीम खेल बना, इससे पहले कबड्डी और क्रिकेट ऐसा कर चुके थे। ट्रैप निशानेबाज़ नीरू ढांडा ने दो स्वर्ण और एक रजत जीता और समापन समारोह में भारत की ध्वजवाहक रहीं।
ओलंपिक काउंसिल ऑफ एशिया ने ध्वज दोहा को सौंपा, जो 2030 एशियाई खेलों की मेज़बानी करेगा। एशियाई पैरा खेल 18 से 24 अक्टूबर तक ऐची-नगोया में होंगे।

gu.title: ભારત આઈચી-નાગોયામાં 85 ચંદ્રક સાથે ચોથા સ્થાને
gu.body: 21 સુવર્ણ, 27 રજત અને 37 કાંસ્ય: હાંગઝોઉ પછી એશિયન ગેમ્સમાં ભારતનું બીજું શ્રેષ્ઠ પ્રદર્શન.
paras: ભારતે આઈચી-નાગોયામાં 20મી એશિયન ગેમ્સનું સમાપન 85 ચંદ્રક સાથે કર્યું: 21 સુવર્ણ, 27 રજત અને 37 કાંસ્ય. આ સાથે ભારત ચંદ્રક તાલિકામાં ચીન, જાપાન અને દક્ષિણ કોરિયા પછી ચોથા સ્થાને રહ્યું.

આ સંખ્યા હાંગઝોઉ (2023માં યોજાયેલી) ના રેકોર્ડ 107 ચંદ્રક કરતાં ઓછી છે, પરંતુ એશિયન ગેમ્સના ઇતિહાસમાં ભારતનું બીજું સૌથી મોટું પ્રદર્શન છે. સૌથી વ્યસ્ત દિવસ 2 ઓક્ટોબર રહ્યો, જ્યારે 12 ચંદ્રક આવ્યા અને તેમાં છ સુવર્ણ હતા.

હોકી પુરુષ અને મહિલા બંને વર્ગમાં સુવર્ણ જીતનાર ત્રીજી ભારતીય ટીમ રમત બની, અગાઉ કબડ્ડી અને ક્રિકેટે આ સિદ્ધિ મેળવી હતી. ટ્રેપ શૂટર નીરુ ઢાંડાએ બે સુવર્ણ અને એક રજત જીત્યા અને સમાપન સમારોહમાં ભારતની ધ્વજવાહક રહ્યાં.
ઓલિમ્પિક કાઉન્સિલ ઓફ એશિયાએ ધ્વજ દોહાને સોંપ્યો, જે 2030 એશિયન ગેમ્સની યજમાની કરશે. એશિયન પેરા ગેમ્સ 18 થી 24 ઓક્ટોબર સુધી આઈચી-નાગોયામાં યોજાશે.
India closed the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya with 85 medals: 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze. That put the contingent fourth on the table, behind China, Japan and South Korea.

The total is below the record 107 medals India won at Hangzhou (held in 2023), but it is still the second-best haul in the country's Asian Games history. The busiest day was 2 October, with 12 medals, six of them gold. In all, 113 Indian athletes won at least one medal.

Hockey became only the third Indian team sport to finish with gold in both the men's and women's events, after kabaddi and cricket. Trap shooter Neeru Dhanda, who won two golds and a silver, carried the flag at the closing ceremony at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium.
The Olympic Council of Asia handed the flag to Doha, which hosts the 2030 Asian Games. The Asian Para Games follow in Aichi-Nagoya from 18 to 24 October.

hi.title: भारत ऐची-नागोया में 85 पदकों के साथ चौथे स्थान पर
hi.body: 21 स्वर्ण, 27 रजत और 37 कांस्य: एशियाई खेलों में भारत का दूसरा सबसे अच्छा प्रदर्शन।
paras: भारत ने ऐची-नागोया में 20वें एशियाई खेलों का समापन 85 पदकों के साथ किया: 21 स्वर्ण, 27 रजत और 37 कांस्य। इसके साथ भारत पदक तालिका में चीन, जापान और दक्षिण कोरिया के बाद चौथे स्थान पर रहा।

यह संख्या हांगझोउ (2023 में आयोजित) के रिकॉर्ड 107 पदकों से कम है, फिर भी एशियाई खेलों के इतिहास में भारत का दूसरा सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन है। प्रतियोगिता के अंतिम दिन, 3 अक्टूबर को, भारत को नौ पदक मिले, जिनमें पाँच स्वर्ण थे।

हॉकी पुरुष और महिला दोनों वर्गों में स्वर्ण जीतने वाला भारत का तीसरा टीम खेल बना; इससे पहले कबड्डी और क्रिकेट ऐसा कर चुके हैं। ट्रैप निशानेबाज़ नीरू ने दो स्वर्ण और एक रजत जीता और समापन समारोह में भारत का ध्वज उठाया।
ओलंपिक काउंसिल ऑफ एशिया ने ध्वज दोहा को सौंपा, जो 2030 के एशियाई खेलों की मेज़बानी करेगा। एशियाई पैरा खेल 18 से 24 अक्टूबर तक ऐची-नागोया में होंगे।

gu.title: ભારત આઇચી-નાગોયામાં 85 ચંદ્રકો સાથે ચોથા સ્થાને
gu.body: 21 સુવર્ણ, 27 રજત અને 37 કાંસ્ય: એશિયન ગેમ્સમાં ભારતનું બીજું શ્રેષ્ઠ પ્રદર્શન.
paras: ભારતે આઇચી-નાગોયામાં 20મી એશિયન ગેમ્સનો અંત 85 ચંદ્રકો સાથે કર્યો: 21 સુવર્ણ, 27 રજત અને 37 કાંસ્ય. ચંદ્રક તાલિકામાં ભારત ચીન, જાપાન અને દક્ષિણ કોરિયા પછી ચોથા સ્થાને રહ્યું.

આ સંખ્યા હાંગઝોઉ (2023માં યોજાયેલી) ના 107 ચંદ્રકોના રેકોર્ડથી ઓછી છે, છતાં એશિયન ગેમ્સના ઇતિહાસમાં ભારતનું બીજું શ્રેષ્ઠ પ્રદર્શન છે. સ્પર્ધાના છેલ્લા દિવસે, 3 ઑક્ટોબરે, ભારતને નવ ચંદ્રકો મળ્યા, જેમાં પાંચ સુવર્ણ હતા.

હૉકી પુરુષ અને મહિલા બંને વર્ગમાં સુવર્ણ જીતનાર ભારતની ત્રીજી ટીમ રમત બની; અગાઉ કબડ્ડી અને ક્રિકેટે આ સિદ્ધિ મેળવી હતી. ટ્રેપ શૂટર નીરુએ બે સુવર્ણ અને એક રજત જીત્યા અને સમાપન સમારોહમાં ભારતનો ધ્વજ ઉપાડ્યો.
ઓલિમ્પિક કાઉન્સિલ ઑફ એશિયાએ ધ્વજ દોહાને સોંપ્યો, જે 2030ની એશિયન ગેમ્સનું યજમાન છે. એશિયન પેરા ગેમ્સ 18 થી 24 ઑક્ટોબર દરમિયાન આઇચી-નાગોયામાં યોજાશે.

ARTICLES.title: Men's cricket team beats Pakistan for Asian Games T20 gold
ARTICLES.body: A 19-run win in the final completes a cricket double for India in Japan.
paras: India's men's team won the T20 gold with a 19-run victory over Pakistan in the final, played at Korogi Athletic Park in Nisshin. Reports credit Abhishek Sharma's 61 and an unbeaten 51 from Tilak Varma for a total of 211.
The result followed the women's team gold from 22 September, when India beat Sri Lanka by 147 runs in the final. Together they gave India gold in both cricket events at the Games.

ARTICLES.title: Neeru Dhanda's record trap gold and a relay win lift India to 10th
ARTICLES.body: Shooting and the women's 4x400m relay deliver two golds on 29 September.
paras: Neeru Dhanda won India's first individual gold of the Games, breaking the Asian Games record in the women's trap final. She later added a second gold in the trap mixed team event with Kynan Chenai.
On the track, Vithya Ramraj, Kiran Pahal, Machettira Poovamma and Prachi won the women's 4x400m relay, India's only athletics gold of the Games.
India collected seven medals on 29 September (two gold, one silver, four bronze), moving to 52 medals (6 gold, 21 silver, 25 bronze) and 10th place at that stage.

ARTICLES.title: Women's cricket team wins Asian Games gold
ARTICLES.body: A 147-run win over Sri Lanka gives India its first gold of the Games.
paras: India's women's cricket team beat Sri Lanka by 147 runs in the final to win India's first gold at Aichi-Nagoya.
Shafali Verma had scored a century in the semi-final, which India won by 114 runs against Bangladesh.

ARTICLES.title: Shooting silvers open India's medal account; MMA debut brings a bronze
ARTICLES.body: Elavenil Valarivan leads the shooting medals while Suchika Tariyal makes history in MMA.
paras: India's first medals of the Games came on 20 September: two silvers in shooting, with Elavenil Valarivan among the medallists.
Mixed martial arts made its Asian Games debut, and Suchika Tariyal secured India's first medal in the sport with a bronze. India reached six medals by 21 September.

ARTICLES.title: Khelo India gets a ₹29,054 crore outlay for 2026–31
ARTICLES.body: The revamped scheme runs across nine components.
paras: The government has notified a revamped Khelo India scheme for 2026–31 with an outlay of ₹29,054 crore across nine components.
The funding sets the backdrop for India's preparation for Los Angeles 2028 and for hosting the Commonwealth Games in Ahmedabad in 2030.

ARTICLES.title: Glasgow 2026 closes: India finish with 39 medals
ARTICLES.body: 13 gold, 17 silver and 9 bronze, and the baton passes to Ahmedabad.
paras: India's Glasgow 2026 campaign ended with 39 medals: 13 gold, 17 silver and 9 bronze, good for fourth place behind Australia, England and Canada.

Neeraj Chopra and PT Usha received the Commonwealth Games flag at the closing ceremony as hosting passed to Ahmedabad, which stages the 2030 Centenary Games, 100 years after the first edition in Hamilton in 1930.

The total is lower than Birmingham 2022's 61 (since revised to 60), but about 30 of those medals came in sports dropped from Glasgow's programme. Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya said India improved from 30 medals in the comparable disciplines to 39.

hi.title: ग्लासगो 2026 का समापन: भारत को 39 पदक
hi.body: 13 स्वर्ण, 17 रजत और 9 कांस्य; अब मेज़बानी अहमदाबाद के पास।
paras: भारत का ग्लासगो 2026 अभियान 39 पदकों के साथ समाप्त हुआ: 13 स्वर्ण, 17 रजत और 9 कांस्य।
समापन समारोह में मेज़बानी अहमदाबाद को सौंपी गई, जो 2030 के शताब्दी खेलों की मेज़बानी करेगा। पहला संस्करण 1930 में हैमिल्टन में हुआ था, यानी ठीक 100 साल पहले।

gu.title: ગ્લાસગો 2026નું સમાપન: ભારતને 39 ચંદ્રકો
gu.body: 13 સુવર્ણ, 17 રજત અને 9 કાંસ્ય; હવે યજમાની અમદાવાદ પાસે.
paras: ભારતનું ગ્લાસગો 2026 અભિયાન 39 ચંદ્રકો સાથે પૂરું થયું: 13 સુવર્ણ, 17 રજત અને 9 કાંસ્ય.
સમાપન સમારોહમાં યજમાની અમદાવાદને સોંપવામાં આવી, જે 2030ની શતાબ્દી ગેમ્સનું આયોજન કરશે. પ્રથમ આવૃત્તિ 1930માં હેમિલ્ટનમાં યોજાઈ હતી, એટલે બરાબર 100 વર્ષ પહેલાં.

ARTICLES.title: India's best Commonwealth Games day: 16 medals, eight golds
ARTICLES.body: Seven golds in the ring, plus a para shot put 1-2.
paras: India's biggest day at Glasgow 2026 brought 16 medals (eight gold, five silver, three bronze). Seven of the golds came in boxing, and Soman Rana added gold in the para shot put F57 with Shubham Juyal taking silver.
Boxing finished with 10 medals, seven of them gold. India's para athletes matched their combined medal haul from all earlier Games.
There were no medals on the final day: judoka Ishroop Narang lost the women's -78kg bronze bout.

ARTICLES.title: Six medals in a day, including gold in the shot put
ARTICLES.body: Silvers in the high jump and weightlifting add to a big Monday.
paras: India won six medals on 27 July (one gold, three silver, two bronze): a gold in the shot put, silvers in the high jump and on the weightlifting platform, and two more bronzes.

ARTICLES.title: Mirabai Chanu opens India's gold account in Glasgow
ARTICLES.body: A Games-record 190kg total in the women's 48kg.
paras: Mirabai Chanu won the women's 48kg gold with a Commonwealth Games record total of 190kg, India's first gold of the Games.
Rishikanta Singh and Raja M added silver medals in the men's lighter weight classes on the same day.

ARTICLES.title: Athletics team named for Glasgow
ARTICLES.body: A 32-member squad was announced by the Athletics Federation of India.
paras: The Athletics Federation of India named a 32-member team for the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, with several medal prospects in the field and on the track.

ARTICLES.title: Ahmedabad 2030: what we know so far
ARTICLES.body: India hosts the Centenary Commonwealth Games.
paras: Ahmedabad will host the 2030 Commonwealth Games, the centenary of the first Games in 1930. Detailed schedule and ticketing information has not been published yet.
The city is home to the Narendra Modi Stadium and the Sabarmati Riverfront, and sits in Gujarat, which has been investing in sports infrastructure.

ARTICLES.title: Road to Los Angeles 2028: what to watch
ARTICLES.body: The next Olympic cycle opens in July 2028.
paras: Los Angeles hosts the Olympic Games from 14 to 30 July 2028. India's most recent Olympic returns were seven medals in Tokyo 2020 and six in Paris 2024.
Qualification windows differ for each sport, so the most useful thing to follow is the world-ranking and continental events through 2026 and 2027.

ARTICLES.title: Next up: Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya from 18 October
ARTICLES.body: India sends its fifth Para Games contingent.
paras: The 2026 Asian Para Games run from 18 to 24 October in Aichi-Nagoya. It will be India's fifth appearance at the Games, with the Paralympic Committee of India fielding the team.

BLOGS.title: How to read a medal table
BLOGS.body: Why India can win more medals than a country ranked above it.
paras: Most Games rank countries by gold medals first, then silver, then bronze. A country with many bronzes can therefore finish below one with a few more golds.
That is why India's 85 medals at Aichi-Nagoya and a tally with fewer golds can sit differently on the table. When comparing editions, look at both the rank and the total.
For a fair long-run view, check gold share (golds divided by total) alongside the total. Our Asian Games analytics page does that for India's recent editions.

BLOGS.title: From Hangzhou to Aichi-Nagoya: India's Asian Games in numbers
BLOGS.body: 107 medals in 2023, 85 in 2026, and a rising team-sport story.
paras: India won a record 107 medals at Hangzhou (28 gold, 38 silver, 41 bronze). In Aichi-Nagoya the team won 85 (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze) and finished fourth.
The 2026 story is also about team sports: cricket, kabaddi and hockey all brought gold in both the men's and women's events.
Across the last five editions India's totals read 65 (Guangzhou 2010), 57 (Incheon 2014), 70 (Jakarta 2018), 107 (Hangzhou) and 85 (Aichi-Nagoya).

BLOGS.title: Olympic moments that shaped Indian sport
BLOGS.body: From Dhyan Chand's hockey golds to Manu Bhaker's double bronze.
paras: Indian hockey won Olympic gold in 1928, 1932 and 1936, with Dhyan Chand as its best-known player. Abhinav Bindra's gold in air rifle at Beijing 2008 was India's first individual Olympic gold.
Neeraj Chopra's javelin gold at Tokyo 2020 was the first Olympic gold for India in athletics, and he followed it with silver at Paris 2024.
At Paris 2024, Manu Bhaker won two bronze medals in a single Games, a first for an Indian athlete since independence.

FAQS: An independent fan publication about Indian sport at the Olympics, Asian Games and Commonwealth Games. We are not affiliated with any official body.
How many medals did India win at Asian Games 2026?
85 in total: 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze, fourth on the medal table.
How many medals did India win at Glasgow 2026?
39 in total: 13 gold, 17 silver and 9 bronze.
Who hosts the next Commonwealth Games?
Ahmedabad, India, hosts the 2030 Centenary Games. Dates and tickets have not been announced.
When are the Asian Para Games?
Why is India's Glasgow total lower than Birmingham's?

Glasgow 2026 had a streamlined programme without hockey, badminton, shooting, wrestling, cricket, squash, table tennis and others. About 30 of India's 61 Birmingham medals (since revised to 60) came in sports that were dropped.
Where do the numbers come from?
Medal counts come from news reports and public records. See Data credits. Always check official sources for results of record.
The signup form in this demo saves your address on your own device only. Connect an email service to send real updates.
Can I use the site in Hindi or Gujarati?
Menus and headings are translated. Article and profile text is currently English only.

ahm.name: Ahmedabad
facts: Largest city in Gujarat, on the Sabarmati river.
Its walled old city was named a UNESCO World Heritage City in 2017.
Hosts the Narendra Modi Stadium in Motera.
go: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport serves the city.
Ahmedabad has a metro and a bus rapid transit system (Janmarg).
ahm.when: October to March is the most comfortable time. Summers are very hot.

nag.name: Aichi-Nagoya
facts: Nagoya is the capital of Aichi Prefecture in central Japan.
Toyota City and Nisshin are in Aichi and hosted events.
go: Chubu Centrair International Airport serves Nagoya.
Shinkansen trains link Nagoya with Tokyo and Osaka.
nag.when: The Asian Games ran from 19 September to 4 October 2026.

OLY_MILESTONES: First Olympic medals
Norman Pritchard, two silvers in athletics in Paris.
First gold
Men's hockey in Amsterdam, the first Olympic gold for an Asian nation.
Six golds in a row
Men's hockey wins every Olympic title from 1928 to 1956. Eight golds in all, the most by any team in the sport.
First individual medal after independence
KD Jadhav, wrestling bronze in Helsinki.
First woman medallist
Karnam Malleswari, weightlifting bronze in Sydney.
First individual gold
Abhinav Bindra, 10m air rifle in Beijing.
First two-time individual medallist
Sushil Kumar adds silver to his 2008 bronze.
First woman with two medals
PV Sindhu, silver in Rio and bronze in Tokyo.
First athletics gold
Neeraj Chopra, javelin in Tokyo. India's best Games with seven medals.
Two medals at one Games
Manu Bhaker, two shooting bronzes in Paris. Aman Sehrawat becomes India's youngest Olympic medallist.
